asr.full_text: What problem does this problem have in TV movies? What did you hear, it is a problem of wheat and wheat, of the elephant or cow. The farmers have never talked about it. If a person who doesn't know about the heart of their family, then he must know the heart of the farmer of the country, of this young people of the country, you tell me... He is repeatedly saying, the duty of the people of the country... I didn't know Abani Ji's duty of this land, got the job, got it? If you got it, let's do this, you have turned it around now, This is my job We used to play this game and get our jobs, but now we are being pushed around the town for no good reason... She is your only job? Yes, she is, because of the money we used to get married, and then she gets me married to a dirty country. And this will also ruin our marriage process. A man who owns a farm will lose everything he owns. And I am not a fortuner, I am a scorpio... So keep your mind clean. Since the score is high, we can try to make the best of it. 5 inch TAPE Listen, brother, you are supposed to get a 56.5 inches chest which they don't want. Second, they should get a chest of 56 inches. They should ask us to be kind, to understand our loss, to cooperate. Let's stay on the right path. Don't listen to the industrialists. We should listen to the farmer and other people. Listen to the people and the farmers. She's just saying that in the next 70 years- The system is not in our hands. Where are we? Where are we dead? Do you want me to look at them? I've seen them daily. But then your Let's leave the TV business. There is no TV drama and media! I think you understand us now that we are stuck in business. You will be suggested with the request to donate you knowledge to us especially towards us. Do you mean to say that he is a scholar? Yes, he is a scholar and after all he is going for free! We have kindly said with him that we don't have any. We have asked for them free of charge and if they say, then we shall let it go. We said no commerce. If they think the knowledge is little, then they know it. It is time to donate to this country. It is a matter between cattle, though the farmers don't. What about the farmers, and their youth, who are actually not aware of the mind of the people in their families? We have left the families for the next generation. All those who left the families and now you're saying they're in charge. Actually we understand why he is such a senior in charge and he is the head of the country. we only understand him was a master's, but now we know from this day is master was our husband he keep on addressing his name as owner of this land we don't know about this person i dont understand him this is total dirt we will talk about Rahul Gandhi second we will talk about Amsar BJP because Rahul I am a thief On this basis, we support him because he is a truthful person He's a truthful person & we shall support him The PM has also taken the claim He has written on the warrant that he will speak the truth The PM had said that his youth can get this job The PM had already spoken his truth Shut up PM Young men will get this much jobs but this is the way! 200 crore jobs were left for the Congress government! The death warranty was given to the people! Have you even got a job? If you do then how about you get yourself a new job? This is our job! Did they pay you? Yes. What have they got with the job? If everyone has a job like this, then're qualified then you would've never done journalism. When does a private employee do a personal job? They gave you some time to be strong till you're in power by 2022. In 2014 I was elected into the prime minister. And it's been several years now. My next plan is that. How much longer will it take? Everything was going well until I got married... and they put a bad word were making arrangements for marriage. He got it spoiled and buried. So, now the marriage will get spoilt too. Who took the trouble? We did. Everything is finished. Tell me, who was in a big trouble in the lockdown? You were able to settle all your family matters. Where are you getting the marriage done? The PM itself said that you'll get the marriage spoiled. Okay. The media is talking about how the media is doing? who is funding , why ? please sit there and see , what is the status there the culture , the way its planted is good that we and the people here These women are not producing a product that is going to use as a source of income and is using the wheat. There's a possibility that we might need to buy extra land. What is this problem? Our farmers have cooperated and are looking after us. Are they not going to starve if they do? I'm tensed now. Can anyone tell me how long we won't be at BJP's den for these arrangements? That's a good point. Eating good. What are you trying to say? BJP are doing it in media and they are calling them wrong. And if they are not working, then why is there a food shortage? All the media and organizations are putting up a TV program about the police. Was there any news about these heavy vehicles for massage in Lahore? Where are these heavy machines? There? Look, I couldn't seen it here. Alright. Secondly… He is a farmer from this country, he has even sold buffalo for few lakhs, okay?! And He has won the Scorpio as a Fortune, so keep your head up, these people might get into a fight, They have such technology and all this chaos and trouble… Listen to me, this person who is the Commissioner of the country, he is a man born from the village, he is a farmer in the country, these 4- of farmers that have earned their lives all alone. How has the farmer earned so much by selling his own land? Then who is poor? The farmers are poor and the food is being distributed to all around the country, there are also imports of rice which are food for the Indians. But we are poor? What else we want? They have made us barren-tardys! What is your plan now? This is the plan. We are going to help the movement effectively, we will support them in using this money This is not what we want, we are doing this with our right, we are coming back from the camps, we are going to use this money. I want people to know my knowledge and wisdom, I don't want people to be against me. And they are going to come back from their political struggles Please teach us about your intelligence That my intelligence is working Do not come against your own people Don't destroy the entire country on the basis of 4 people Don't come to them Adani Ambani are going to starve to death They want to have names in their top list Merel's names are required to be in the top list Modi Ji should have been in people's hearts He should have been in their hearts Modi Ji is doing a mistake Please tell us about your intelligence What does the list mean about the rich? Dr. Modi has to live and work for people. Dr. Modi is wrong and should be taught to manage their intellects. We will arrange to get someone else to take care of themselves but I think I think what would he prefer to sing. Now, the problem is- farmers' movement? Cows, chickens, elephants, camels and cats. How will that make you think? There is a huge movement taking place in the country but he doesn't talk about it. The first day of this campaign is here in Poonam. All these 3 laws are not returned. For NEWSINTA and ARNEWSINDIA, Akil Razak reporting for Delhi.
